Package domain

Class Entity

java.lang.Object
domain.Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Ball, FakeBall, Player
public abstract class Entity extends Object implements Serializable
Anything that moves on the field: the players, the ball and the fake balls. It keeps a position, a velocity and a rectangular box, in pixels, pixels per second and seconds. Entities do not move by themselves: PhysicsEngine moves them with the physics library and copies the result back.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
